templates.name: Leave Application
templates.defaultSubject: Application for Grant of Academic Leave
templates.defaultBody:
Respected Sir,

With due respect, I beg to state that I am unable to attend my regular lectures due to pressing personal reasons. I request you to kindly grant me leave for the specified duration.

I assure you that I will cover any missed coursework or lab tasks immediately upon my return.

templates.name: Section Change
templates.defaultSubject: Application for Requesting Change of Class Section
templates.defaultBody:
Respected Sir,

I respectfully request permission to change my current academic section. Due to unavoidable schedule conflicts and genuine academic reasons, attending lectures in my current section has become challenging.

I humbly request your approval to transfer my enrollment to the requested section.

templates.name: Course Registration
templates.defaultBody:
Respected Sir,

With due respect, I wish to submit my request for registering the specified course(s) for the current academic semester. I have fulfilled all prerequisites required for enrollment.

Kindly allow me to formally register for the course(s) listed below.

templates.name: Fee Issue
templates.defaultSubject: Application Regarding Fee Challan Verification / Extension
templates.defaultBody:
Respected Sir,

I am writing to bring to your attention a matter regarding my semester fee voucher/challan. Due to unexpected financial constraints/processing delays, I request your kind consideration and assistance in resolving this issue.

Details of my voucher are attached for your reference.

templates.name: Other (AI Prompt)
templates.defaultBody:
Respected Sir,

With due respect, I am writing to formally request your assistance regarding the aforementioned subject.

I kindly request you to consider my application and grant necessary approval.
